rules.label: partial_range
rules.rest_note: Next set, try curling until your forearm comes up close to your upper arm.

rules.label: elbow_drift
rules.rest_note: Your elbows drifted forward on {n} reps. Elbows that stay by your sides keep the work in the biceps.

rules.label: torso_swing
rules.rest_note: Your upper body swung on {n} reps. A still torso keeps the work in your arms.

rules.label: fast_lowering
rules.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. Around 2 s gives you more control.

knee.extra_note: Curls put little load on the knees. A seated curl takes the knees out of the movement entirely.

elbow_drift.rest_note: Your elbows drifted forward on {n} reps. Elbows that stay by your sides go easier on a recovering shoulder.

shoulder.extra_note: The elbow position limit here is set tighter to suit a recovering shoulder. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.

torso_swing.rest_note: Your upper body swung on {n} reps. A still torso keeps the load off your lower back.

lower_back.extra_note: The swing limit here is set tighter to go easy on a recovering lower back. A lighter weight often makes a still torso easier. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.
